transitions.evidence: Nitin Sinha研究将公司特许公务员主持的鸦片代理实际建立写在1799年，说明鸦片收购从承包商负责转向由公司职员直接同制造者和种植者对接。

major_cautions: 1761 commercial opium monopoly not a new precise cadastral territory.
1773 contract initially forbade forcing ryots to plant; 1788 Cornwallis found practical coercion.
1793 Bihar right not to plant different from 1799 requirements to deliver opium only to company agent.
1780 salt agencies are operational procurement units, not proof Britain conquered whole east Indian coastline.
1792 famine witnessed hunger in Circars; drought and warfare must be analyzed alongside colonial tax and relief.
Modern city points not places of individual victims or borders; no made-up production-famine polygons.
